snippet.title: This Is What a Gunshot Really Sounds Like | Devlog [2/4]
snippet.description:
🎮 Play Bodycam on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2406770/Bodycam/

Welcome to the second devlog in our 4-part series. This episode focuses entirely on BODYCAM’s sound design and the technologies we developed to bring its audio experience to life.

The response to our first devlog has been incredible. Our video on IGN surpassed 1 million views in only 2 days, and BODYCAM is now approaching 3 million wishlists, so go smash that wishlist button!

You can also sign up for the playtest taking place at the end of August. We will announce the exact dates very soon.

We are truly grateful for all your messages. Many of you share our vision and our ambition to revolutionize the tactical FPS genre, and that genuinely means a lot to the entire team.

The remaining devlogs will be released on our YouTube channel, so make sure to subscribe so you don’t miss them.
